Quick SRE triage update (summary of findings):

Observations:
- We correlated the sample request_ids against our rate limiter logs. The customer hit multiple quota windows back-to-back; their per-tenant burst allowance was exhausted.
- Enforcement path: a new burst-enforcement rule (deployed 04/24) mistakenly treated Stormcrest as a burstless tenant due to a tag mismatch in account metadata. That caused strict deny once the soft window was exceeded.
- There is not a code-level bug in token bucket math; it's an attribute/metadata mapping error causing incorrect policy selection.

Immediate mitigations (proposed):
1) Lift the strict burst enforcement for stc-prod-01 (temporary override) — ETA 10 minutes, risk: short period of higher GPU consumption; mitigations: 30m timebox + autoscale watch.
2) Enable fallback routing to the compatible model-variant (lower throughput per-request but more permissive queuing) — ETA 20 minutes.
3) Continue root-cause work: fix metadata sync and add unit/integration tests for tag mapping — ETA 48 hours for rollout.

I pushed a PagerDuty incident and attached a throughput chart showing the windowed bursts (link below). I'll start the override if we have approval from CS/Account and a promise to monitor.

Vivek
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
